# DocVQA Skill

## Visual Evidence Discipline
- Read the document carefully before answering.
- Return the smallest answer-bearing span that directly satisfies the requested field. Do not use minimality to truncate a proper name, title, list, or other field whose full printed span is the answer; preserve all components that identify the requested entity.
- For a quantity or count, if the question or field label already supplies the unit or counted category, answer with the value from the matching field or cell and do not append a repeated category word, a second unit, an unexplained equivalent representation, or an unrequested conversion. When the question asks for a count and already names the counted category, return the number alone; do not append the category noun even when the document prints it directly beside the number. The guidance to preserve full printed spans protects a field's own printed name, title, or attached unit, not a category word that merely restates the question. Still keep an attached printed measurement unit, currency, symbol, or equivalent when the question does not already supply it, including when it is inseparable from the value; keep the category only when the question asks you to name the category rather than count it.
- Before finalizing, re-read the chosen span and remove only additions that are not part of that span.
- When the question asks for a value tied to a label, identifier, row, or column, first locate the exact label or identifier, then read the value that shares the same row/line or adjacent cell. Verify that the requested label and selected value are visibly paired, and do not substitute closely related labels or adjacent numbered rows for one another.
- When a question asks for a person's designation, role, position, or title, and the visible text places a role/title next to a broader organizational affiliation such as a department, institute, employer, or address, select the role/title span that directly answers the question rather than appending the separate affiliation.
- Treat a line break, comma, or shift from a role term to an organizational unit as a cue to test whether the material after the role is a separate affiliation. Do not strip words needed to identify the role itself.
- Do not minimize full person names, organization names, quoted titles, or a full affiliation when the question asks for the affiliation or when the requested field is visibly printed as one inseparable span. If the document is genuinely ambiguous about whether the affiliation is part of the title, prefer the smallest complete role/title span supported by the label-value structure.
- If two candidate values are near, choose the one whose row/column alignment and label match the question, not simply the nearest-looking string; do not answer with a value from a different field merely because it appears in the same block.

## Exact Answer Discipline
- Copy names, numbers, and dates exactly from the document whenever possible.
- Prefer direct extraction over paraphrase.
- Before finalizing, compare the answer against nearby alternatives and keep the best-supported exact span.
